run_libsize_check: run libsize.py on a .so file to display its size and compare against a saved baseline
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py with a .so file and save file to compare current size to previous build
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py on a new .so file to establish a size baseline in a save file
review_libsize_output: review the libsize.py output to see byte and percentage change between builds
summarize_libsize_script: summarize the libsize.py script which measures .so file sizes and tracks changes across builds
